native_port_adapter.note: DECLARED dead-pin tie (QC-EVENT-S25 11-11, DIE-QC-99, COORD ruling 11-11): core u_suvm_u_vm8q_u_va (qfd_dv_s8x_vmr) pins ft_ck_i, ft_rst_i tied 1'b0; ft_ck_o, ft_rst_o unconsumed (physical_ft.unconsumed_outputs).
